hook.head: Claude Code shortcuts you need.
hook.vo: Three Claude Code shortcuts that will save you so much time.

tips.vo: Claude going the wrong way? Press Escape to stop it right away, then tell it what you actually want.
tips.head: Press Esc to stop it.

tips.vo: Type the at sign and a file name, to point Claude straight at the right file. No guessing, and no searching your whole project.
tips.head: Use @ to point at files.

tips.vo: Finished one task, and starting another? Type slash clear for a fresh start, so old context doesn't confuse the new task.
tips.head: /clear between tasks.
